title: festuca ovina subvar. caesia
intro: Festuca ovina subvar. caesia, commonly known as Blue Fescue, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The health benefits of Blue Fescue include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate stress. The bioactive constituents present in Blue Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects.
